reason: Target-context descriptor is identical for all constructed queries in a frame. A single row argmin can mechanically choose the first native row while the nearest frame contains both D and E. Preserve original argmin IDs for reproducibility and do not interpret deterministic tied row labels as unique semantic support.
policy: Before computing tie counts, fix absolute FP32 cosine-distance equality tolerance at 1e-7 for every component. Report min-distance-to-D and min-distance-to-E and ties separately, no tolerance tuning and no predictive classification or fitted decision threshold. Supplement query-weighted context distances with one first eligible original query per frame and count unique nearest TRAIN frames.
causal_limit: TRAIN leave-frame-out can retain nearby temporal/scene frames while held is a fixed distinct scene group. Distances are descriptive source support, not proof of causal domain shift or independent physical examples.
